segments.speaker: Dana Lee, Customer
segments.text:
Hi Mark,

Can you send pricing for 86 seats of the customer portal package? We’re targeting a September 16 go-live and would want the admin training included.

Thanks,
Dana

segments.speaker: Mark Rivera, Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dana,

For 86 seats, annual term, the total is $48,360. That includes the portal package, standard support, and two admin training sessions. Implementation is a flat $4,500 one-time fee.

Mark

segments.speaker: Dana Lee, Customer
segments.text: Thanks. We’re approved for $44,000 on subscription this year. If we drop to 80 seats, does that get us there? Implementation is already covered in a separate budget.

segments.speaker: Mark Rivera, Rep
segments.text: At 80 seats the annual subscription comes to $44,800. Same support and training included. The 12-month term would run September 16, 2026 through September 15, 2027.

segments.speaker: Dana Lee, Customer
segments.text: Understood. We really need to keep the 86 seats because our field managers are included now. Is there any room if we sign this week?

segments.speaker: Mark Rivera, Rep
segments.text:
Dana,

The $43,200 for 86 seats we landed on over text works if you can sign by Friday. I haven’t run that concession through deal desk yet, but I’ll send the order form at that amount and sort the approval paperwork after.

Mark

segments.speaker: Dana Lee, Customer
segments.text: Okay. Please send it with the September 16 start date, net 30 payment terms, and the implementation fee shown separately.

segments.speaker: Mark Rivera, Rep
segments.text:
Attached is the order form.

Summary:
86 seats
Subscription: $43,200
Implementation: $4,500
Start date: September 16, 2026
Initial term: 12 months
Payment: net 30

Mark

segments.speaker: Dana Lee, Customer
segments.text: Received. Legal is fine with the standard terms. I’ll route for signature this afternoon and send back the completed copy.
